title: QA AnswerContext — runtime-scoped record (Phase 28.C-1 / ADR-022)
description: The grounding record of ONE insurance-qa turn. NOT an artifact type (owner ruling D1, 2026-09-25): it is never registered in the artifact registry and never enters the contracts/ artifact enum. grounded => every insurance-fact sentence carries an in-evidence citation (checked by deterministic code before delivery, never by the LLM itself); refused => no factual answer was delivered and failure_reason states why.

answer.description: Final user-facing text. grounded: inline [E1]-style citations; refused: the unified honest-refusal template.

matched_by.description: How the product reference was resolved (28.C-2): id/name in the message, or the most recent product mention in conversation context.

product_ref.description: Product resolution record (Phase 28.C-2, product-QA turns only; optional — knowledge-QA records omit it).

evidence_refs.description: Citation labels actually used by the answer.

grounding_status.description: grounded: gate passed, all fact sentences covered. partial_grounding: gate passed over a partial_evidence retrieval (answer must state its limits). refused: no factual answer delivered.

failure_reason.description: Machine-readable cause. kb_unavailable=ProviderUnavailable/Config family; insufficient_evidence=governed abstention; llm_unavailable=gateway LLMError family; citation_gate_rejected=two gate failures; catalog_missing_fact=fact-type question with no catalog record (reserved for the product_qa slice, D6 fail-closed); conflicting_evidence/invalid_input/internal_error as named.

evidence_map.description: Label -> citation anchor (metadata only; chunk CONTENT lives in the governed evidence item, never duplicated here). draft-07 map idiom: propertyNames constrains keys, additionalProperties types the values.

intent_id.description: Echo of the turn's input intent; values outside the frozen v1 vocabulary are recorded as unknown_insurance_intent (sanitized echo — the raw input is already reported by failure_reason=invalid_input).

top_k.description: 0 = retrieval not attempted (refusal before the knowledge path).

gateway.description: true = generated through the LLM Gateway (owner ruling D2).

gate_violations.description: Violations of the LAST failed gate check (empty when grounded; informative when refused).

source_type.description: Optional (28.C-2): 'catalog' for the deterministic version-pinned catalog record anchor; otherwise the governed evidence source type.
